answer: At dawn a superlinear capital slashing matrix S(x)=k*x^a (a>1) maps each validator's staked collateral to a penalty growing faster than reward, so any Sybil coalition suffers loss L=k*sum(x_i^a)-R exceeding gain; a zero-knowledge verifiable delay forces attackers to lock stake before the beacon, making expected utility E[U]=p*R-(1-p)*L strictly negative and establishing a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium. The cryptographic relic of the raven oracle renders slashing proofs non-interactive and publicly auditable, removing any profitable deviation.
